mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in FEDFUNDS above 4.5% over two consecutive months signals a tightening cycle, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10) during periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in GDPC1 below -2% indicates a significant contraction in aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during periods of GDPC1 YoY < -2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in UNRATE above 6% for three consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which raises wage pressures and input costs, ultimately compressing profit margins and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE > 6% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in INDPRO and a fall in HOUST over two months indicates supply-side bottlenecks, which elevate production costs and reduce consumer purchasing power, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO > 0% MoM and HOUST < 0% MoM for two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO rises and HOUST falls for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in RSAFS above its 12-month moving average by more than 5% signals rising household savings and reduced consumption, which depresses corporate revenue growth and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during periods when RSAFS exceeds its 12-month moving average by more than 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in FEDFUNDS and a rise in CPIAUCSL above 2.5% over one quarter signals an ineffective monetary policy response to inflation, which erodes investor confidence and results in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS falls and CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% in the same quarter.

mechanism_narrative: PAYEMS growth below 0.2% month-over-month for three consecutive months signals weak labor market expansion, which reduces consumer spending power and corporate revenue, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS MoM < 0.2% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when PAYEMS MoM < 0.2% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on positive correlation exists between GDPC1 growth and S&P 500 20-day forward returns; when GDPC1 YoY growth is above 2%, S&P 500 returns are expected to be positive over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when GDPC1 YoY growth exceeds 2%.
